image_description: A close-up, side-profile photograph of a Rock Beauty angelfish (Holocanthus tricolor) against a dark background. The fish displays the characteristic black anterior body and head, transitioning to a bright yellow posterior body and tail. A distinct blue eye ring is visible. Behind the main subject, partially obscured, is the head of a second, darker fish.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Small protrusible mouth with brush-like teeth.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The mouth is small, located at the tip of the snout, and appears consistent with the protrusible morphology of angelfish. While individual 'brush-like teeth' are not resolvable at this resolution, the macro-structure matches.
The eye is prominent relative to the head size, featuring a distinct blue iris ring, matching the species description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Laterally compressed disc-shaped body with compact proportions.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The body exhibits high lateral compression and an oval/disc-like silhouette typical of Holocanthus species.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Striking gold and black coloration: anterior body and head black, posterior body and tail golden yellow with black margin.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The color pattern is diagnostic: the front half is deep black/dark blue, and the rear half is vibrant yellow. The transition is sharp and correctly positioned.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Continuous dorsal fin with spiny anterior and soft-rayed posterior portions.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The dorsal fin runs continuously along the back. The texture change from spiny (anterior) to soft-rayed (posterior) is visually discernible.
The anal fin mirrors the dorsal fin's structure and position on the ventral side.
The caudal fin (tail) has a clearly rounded margin, distinguishing it from forked or lunate tails.

selected_experts.reason: Primary verification of species identity against ImageNet classes to rule out look-alike angelfish species.
To verify the integrity of the fin edges and ensure no 'melting' into the dark background, especially around the complex scale patterns.
To assess the naturalness of the scale texture and lighting reflections, checking for AI-generated smearing or noise artifacts.

focus_areas: Scale texture consistency across the black/yellow boundary
Boundary separation between the primary fish and the background/secondary fish
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the transition zone between the black and yellow sections of the body. AI generators often blur this line or create unnatural gradients. Also, inspect the secondary fish in the background; check if it is structurally coherent or if it appears as a distorted artifact of the generation process.
